commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git rev-parse --show-toplevel && git rev-parse HEAD && git branch --show-current'

/bin/zsh -lc 'for f in docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/*.json docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/raw/*.json docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/schemas/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path('docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate')
verdict=json.loads((root/'verdict.json').read_text())
missing=[p for p in verdict['raw_evidence']+[verdict['preflight']['log']] if not (root/p).exists()]
print('missing evidence paths:', missing)
print('root verdict count:', len(list(root.rglob('verdict.json'))))
sys.exit(1 if missing or len(list(root.rglob('verdict.json'))) "'!= 1 else 0)
PY'

/bin/zsh -lc 'for f in docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/*.json docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/raw/*.json docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/schemas/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done; echo json-ok'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git add -A && git commit -m "test(acceptance): record T2182 phase-one blocked gate" && git push origin HEAD'
/bin/zsh -lc "git config --get-regexp '"'^remote'"\\.(origin|origin-push)\\.' && git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD"
/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname)' refs/heads refs/remotes/origin refs/remotes/origin-push | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path('docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate')
verdict=json.loads((root/'verdict.json').read_text())
missing=[p for p in verdict['raw_evidence']+[verdict['preflight']['log']] if not (root/p).exists()]
count=len(list(root.rglob('verdict.json')))
result=verdict['result']
product=verdict['product_verdict']
print(f'verdict_result={result}')
print(f'product_verdict={product}')
print(f'fixture_status={verdict[\"checks\"][\"fresh_fixture_via_official_api\"][\"status\"]}')
print(f'fixture_manifest_sha256={verdict[\"fixture_manifest_sha256\"]}')
print(f'run_root_verdict_count={count}')
print(f'missing_evidence_paths={missing}')
if result "'!= '"'BLOCKED/NOT_RUN' or product "'!= '"'NOT_RUN' or count "'!= 1 or missing:
    sys.exit(1)
PY'

/bin/zsh -lc 'for f in docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/*.json docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/raw/*.json docs/acceptance/t2182-phase1-method-gate/schemas/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done; echo '"'JSON_PARSE=pass'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'base=ddfb87d47e8253fb2e4f22d014f497301fa4b7ec
head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
printf '"'base=%s\\nhead=%s\\nbranch=%s\\n' \""'$base" "$head" "$branch"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$base" HEAD && echo '"'HEAD_AHEAD_BASE=pass' || echo 'HEAD_AHEAD_BASE=fail'
printf 'ahead_count='; git rev-list --count \""'$base"..HEAD
printf '"'worktree_status='; if [ -z \""'$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo clean; else echo dirty; git status --short; fi
remote=$(git ls-remote origin-push "refs/heads/$branch" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
printf 'remote_ref=refs/heads/%s\\nremote_head=%s\\n' \""'$branch" "$remote"
if [ "$remote" = "$head" ]; then echo '"'REMOTE_DELIVERY_REF=pass'; else echo 'REMOTE_DELIVERY_REF=fail'; fi"
